title: ZenCraft
description: Focus Mode enhances your Minecraft experience by filtering entities (animals, items, players) and simplifying the HUD for a distraction-free building session, with an optional Pomodoro timer to manage your playtime.
body:
Focus Mode** enhances your Minecraft building experience by eliminating visual distractions. Press X to enter focus mode – animals, item drops, and nametags vanish while monsters remain visible for safety. Other players appear semi-transparent so you're never fully isolated.

Features:
- Toggle Focus Mode with X, settings with Y
- Filter what renders: animals, monsters, players, items, nametags
- Player transparency (configurable opacity)
- Minimal HUD – only crosshair + focus overlay
- Built-in Pomodoro timer with sound alert
- All settings configurable in-game or via config/focus-mode.json
